newsitem.title: GERMANY: German music channel names new management team.
newsitem.headline: German music channel names new management team.

text.p: Onyx Television, Germany's newest music video channel, said on Wednesday it had shuffled its management team.
Charles Koppel will take over as general manager of Onyx Television GmbH and sit in London, the station said, and Stuart Pinches has been named company proxy manager for Germany.
Michael Denholm, previously with Onyx parent company Capital Media Group Ltd in London, will join the station as sales and marketing representative in Germany.
The company said Onyx, which started broadcasting popular music videos last year, can be seen across Europe by satellite.
